# Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs — facts

## How it works

- [statement] Design inference: a customer-owned Azure Functions timer can invoke the export command on a schedule. Microsoft documents timer scheduling; MongoDB documents the Feed Downstream Systems interval wizard for AWS S3 using Atlas Triggers. These sources do not establish an Azure scheduling wizard or a tested end-to-end Functions integration. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-06-21) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-functions/functions-bindings-timer · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/tutorial/deploy/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Azure document-write errors produce out-error-docs/<i>.json, out-error-index/<i>.json and out-error-summary.json beneath container/atlas-data-lake-<correlation-id>/. Design inference: examine these artifacts before accepting export completeness. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/pipeline/out/ · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs
- [statement] Run db.aggregate([{$currentOp:{}}]) against admin to observe running work. opid matches correlationID; progress.workDone indicates activity, not percentage completion or remaining work. A pipeline containing only $currentOp remains usable at the simultaneous-query limit. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/admin/determine-query-status/ · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs
- [statement] Query admin with [{$queryHistory:{}},{$match:{comment:runId}}] after attaching a unique command comment. History records endTime, ok, error, background and opid; ok is 1 for success and 0 for errors. Retention is seven days. allUsers defaults false and requires viewAllHistory when enabled. Design inference: persist job results outside this retention window. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/view-query-history/ · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs
- [statement] MONGOSH-932, updated 2025-05-07, reports the aggregate helper dropping background:true and contrasts it with db.runCommand. Linked driver and warning work is closed, but the parent remains unresolved. This is historical evidence for verifying option transmission, not proof every current shell or driver is affected. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-05-07) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOSH-932 · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Azure Functions timer documentation says a running invocation suppresses another invocation and the timer trigger itself does not retry failures before the next scheduled time. Design inference: explicitly design failure recovery rather than assuming the timer supplies it. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-06-21) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-functions/functions-bindings-timer · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Invoke the pipeline against the federated database instance. The Azure target is $out.azure with serviceURL, containerName, filename and format.name; include region explicitly. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/pipeline/out/ · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-atlas-data-federation-azure-blob/view
- [statement] For asynchronous submission, use db.runCommand with aggregate, pipeline ending in $out.azure, and top-level background:true; disconnection need not stop execution. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/pipeline/out/ · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOSH-932
- [statement] Azure export requires an Azure role granting read/write access and a database user with atlasAdmin or custom outToAzure privilege. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/pipeline/out/ · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs
- [statement] Matching output names overwrite existing blobs. Design inference: assign each scheduled attempt a distinct filename prefix. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/pipeline/out/ · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs
- [statement] Design inference: retain a separate in-flight export record after the timer function returns. Timer exclusion protects its invocation, whereas background export continues independently; this does not guarantee export-job serialization. (medium confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-functions/functions-bindings-timer · keywords: Customer-scheduled Data Federation Azure Blob out jobs · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/pipeline/out/
